notes.title: Change in Blob From Space
notes.content:
As many of you know, the last couple of months there hasn't been a big update to Blob From Space. I will change that, but sadly need to change some ideas of the game as well. My idea:

Blob From Space will become a 2D platformer combined with a text based adventure. The choises you make will have impact on the story and the 2D platform levels you will be playing. 

There will be 4 short stories.
- Blob From Space: Origins
- Blob From Space goes Hollywood
- Blob From Space: Defenders of the multiverse
- Blob From Space: Light V Dark

Each planet you see in the game will start a story. There will be different achievements in the game which are unlockable in the 2D platform levels, but there are also achievements that are only unlockable during the text story. So playing a story again will unlock different achievements.

I hope you guys like the idea and the path we're going on and hope you will like the stories as well. 

The planning is to release the first short story in December or atleast January.

Keep playing and have a nice day!
- Jos

notes.title: Added YOLO mode
notes.content:
For the people that are in for a challenge we added YOLO mode.
Go to the Cheat menu and use the cheat "YOLOMODE" to start the challenge.

If you succeed you will get the YOLO mode achievement, so good luck!

Next update will include:
- Christmas challenge
- 3 new story levels
- Retro mode levels (+ Retro achievement unlockable)
- Gold coin in story mode that adds a continue
- Borat hat (+ Very nice! achievement)

If you found any bugs, please contact me (Using the forums) and I will fix it.

ːjosː

notes.title: 1 November update
notes.content:
As some of you already have seen we added Steam cloud.
At this moment Steam cloud will save your Diamond Rush highscore and the settings. So where ever you go you can keep practising to beat your Diamond Rush highscore. We also need Steam cloud to work with the level select. So you don't have to repeat the levels over and over whereever you are.

We also added some smooth camera movement in the game and there is a way to use different camera settings. You can play from a big distance (Use the F1 button) or play with closeup (F2).

We also edit some new images and animations.

Hope you like this small update.
ːjosː

notes.title: New features coming soon!
notes.content:
Soon we will be adding some new features into the game.
- Blob Wall Jump power: Jump against walls to reach places you weren't able to reach with normal jumps.
- Level select: After reading feedback from some players we found out they're not too happy with the cheats menu so we're changing that into a level select. From here you can choose a level and continue that story from that level. NOTE: Some achievements will not work when using level select.
This level select screen will also have a simple Blob editor for now. Where you can choose your hat (One you picked up during the story) to play with. 
- Practise mode: Is there a level you can't seem to finish? Use practise mode and try the level over and over and over again. You can only practise levels that you played during the normal story mode. NOTE: Some achievements will not work using practise mode.

It will take some time before we get these features in the game, still have to do some research about using Steam cloud to save your progress of the game.

Happy Gaming,
- JosPlays
